ui_adm_reset_desc: Wipes all livestock, troughs, coops, storages (and their contents), supply orders and ownership, and fires every member of staff. No refund is paid.
ui_adm_add_storage_desc: Adds an extra storage to this ranch free of charge.
ui_adm_settings_desc: Overrides for this ranch. Saved to the database, applied instantly for every player and kept across restarts. Leave a field blank to use the config value.
ui_adm_confirm_owner: Make %s the owner of %s? The current owner (if any) will be removed from the ranch job.
ui_adm_confirm_remove_owner: Remove %s as owner? Livestock and storages are kept and the ranch goes back up for sale.
ui_adm_confirm_reset: Reset %s to default? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_fire_all: Fire every member of staff at %s (the owner is kept)?
ui_adm_confirm_delete_all: Delete all %s animals at %s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_delete_animal: Delete animal #%s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_empty: Empty every item out of %s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_delete_storage: Delete %s and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_reset_settings: Reset %s back to its config values?
sv_adm_no_permission: You do not have permission to use the ranch admin panel
sv_adm_busy: Another admin action is running on this ranch, try again
sv_adm_failed: That action failed - check the server console
sv_adm_no_player: No player found with that server ID or citizen ID
sv_adm_max_jobs: That player already holds the maximum number of jobs
sv_adm_already_owner: That player already owns this ranch
sv_adm_owner_removed: Owner removed - the ranch is now for sale
sv_adm_fire_owner: Remove the owner from the Ownership tab instead
sv_adm_general_storage: The free general storage cannot be deleted - empty it instead
sv_adm_given_ranch: An admin has made you the owner of %s
ui_adm_search_player: Search by name or citizen ID...
ui_adm_nobody_online: Nobody online - type a name to search all characters
ui_adm_pick_player: Pick a player from the search results first
ui_adm_new_ranch_desc: The ranch NPC is placed exactly where you are standing now, facing the way you face. The animal spawn point is set 10m in front of you - you can move both afterwards from the Ownership tab.
ui_adm_ranch_id_hint: Lowercase letters and numbers only. This is also the job name the ranch's staff are given, so it can't be changed later.
ui_adm_need_name: Enter a name for the ranch
ui_adm_custom_hint: Created in this panel. Stand where you want it and use the buttons above to move the NPC or the animal spawn point.
ui_adm_confirm_npc_here: Move the %s NPC to where you are standing now?
ui_adm_confirm_spawn_here: Move the %s animal spawn point to where you are standing now?
ui_adm_delete_ranch_desc: Permanently removes this ranch: its NPC, blip, livestock, troughs, coops, storages, orders, staff and its job.
ui_adm_confirm_delete_ranch: Permanently delete %s and everything on it? This cannot be undone.
sv_adm_custom_only: Only ranches created in the admin panel can be moved or deleted - edit config.lua for the others
sv_adm_bad_name: Enter a name for the ranch
sv_adm_bad_id: Ranch ID must be 3-40 lowercase letters or numbers
sv_adm_id_taken: That ranch ID or job name is already in use
sv_adm_ranch_created: %s created - its NPC is where you are standing
sv_no_grade_permission: Your job grade at this ranch is not allowed to do that
